newsitem.title: CHINA: DRAGONAIR AWAITS APPROVAL FOR WUHAN LINK.
newsitem.headline: DRAGONAIR AWAITS APPROVAL FOR WUHAN LINK.

text.p: Hong Kong Dragon Airlines Ltd (Dragonair) is awaiting the go-ahead to begin a scheduled passenger service between Hong Kong and Wuhan, an airline spokeswoman said.
The twice weekly Airbus A320 service is expected to begin next month once final approval is given by the Chinese authorities, she added.
"We had hoped to begin in August but now we are targetting September and are ready to go. We just need the final go ahead," the spokeswoman said.
Wuhan further strengthens Dragonair's network in mainland China and will be the Hong Kong airline's 17th Chinese destination and 26th regional destination.
Dragonair will be in competition with China Southern Airlines on the route.

Citic Pacific Ltd owns 26 percent of Dragonair, while Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd and Swire Pacific Ltd each 26 percent in the carrier. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
